# Startup readback: AI-35

Contract version: 1

## Objective and acceptance outcomes

Build the canonical Career evidence path over approved personal GitHub data and supplied evidence while making the repository-owner boundary fail closed.

1. Normalize personal repository metadata and dated commit, PR, release, and documentation references into evidence that supports project/technology/skill signals with provenance and freshness; activity volume alone cannot establish a skill.
2. Every repository/API target is checked server-side against the exact `Matthew-Irving5` allowlist, with a case-insensitive `BrightSG` hard deny and non-allowlisted-owner rejection before any GitHub fetch.
3. Unchanged syncs remain incremental/idempotent, approved manual evidence remains traceable, and Career adds no outbound recruiter/contact capability.

## Dependencies and relevant contracts

AI-15 (canonical run lifecycle) and AI-19 (correlated trace, evidence, provenance, and freshness) are Done. Their completion links are PR #165 and PR #171; shared integration guidance was added in PR #172. The Build Spec §19.2 allows only exact owner `Matthew-Irving5`, forbids BrightSG, and keeps GitHub read-only. The Agent Spec §39 reuses `career_github_evidence` with hard owner validation and requires evidence-backed career state. The Frontend Constitution §35.6 prioritizes trajectory, projects, opportunities, skills, and technology radar; evidence visualizations remain evidence-driven.

Using the existing `apps/web/app/api/career/github-sync` → `github-career-sync` Edge contract; integration risks are GITHUB-01 and GITHUB-02.

## Implementation and boundaries

Inspect the existing Career GitHub Edge Function, database schema/RLS, connector contracts, evidence/freshness helpers, and tests before editing. Extend the established sync and evidence path rather than adding a parallel provider or changing locked identity. Validate the inbound owner request before MFA/provider work, verify the configured token via GitHub `/user`, and allow repository requests only after exact identity validation. Test that denied owners trigger zero repository calls. Do not access, search, clone, query, or modify any repository outside `Matthew-Irving5`; tests may only assert that prohibited owners are rejected before fetch. Preserve source URLs, source dates, provenance, and freshness; allow manually supplied evidence only through the existing approved path. No autonomous outreach, Drive dependency, or speculative UI/schema rewrite.

## Local tests and commands

Narrow owner-guard and evidence normalization/dedupe/freshness tests first; Edge Function fixtures must assert zero repository calls for `BrightSG` and other owners. Then run affected SQL/RLS/contract proofs as needed, `corepack pnpm verify:changed`, and `node infrastructure/scripts/ticket-readback.mjs check AI-35`. The local AI-35 pgTAP test covers source dates, documentation evidence, closed evidence kinds, and duplicate upsert behavior. Detail reads are capped to the five most recently updated personal repositories; each row retains the source URL/date and retrieval date, while provider prose is discarded.

## Hosted proof and readiness

The operator signed in with fresh MFA and synced against candidate `3835c622c9288ae6895f0a07f910c130470df5d2`, deployed by staging run `39639201782`. Career showed 50 evidence records with only `Matthew-Irving5` source links and source/retrieval timestamps; the operator repeated sync and confirmed no new records (still 50). On that candidate, authenticated `BrightSG` and `OtherOwner` input probes returned `400 request.validation` at the web proxy, before its Edge dispatch. That exposed a proxy/Edge contract mismatch: the proxy prevented the Edge owner-denial audit from recording the safe event. The follow-up forwards only the documented owner-target shapes to the authenticated Edge guard while keeping unknown fields closed. Its focused route regression passed 3/3 and `corepack pnpm verify:changed --lane=core` passed; staging must be redeployed at the follow-up SHA to prove the audited 403 denial before this ticket can complete. The Career page itself has no summary-generation control; the issue's bounded evidence-backed summary acceptance remains unresolved. Do not inspect prohibited repository content.
